data.name: Astik
data.gender_notes: Astik is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit root ‘asti’, meaning ‘is’ or ‘exists’. The name Astik signifies one who holds steadfast faith in the divine. The name Astik carries the meaning “Faithful, Devoted” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Astik usually hope their child will grow to embody faithful, devoted and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of unwavering devotion and belief in the higher power.
data.etymology: Astik belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Faithful, Devoted.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Astik total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
